verdict.rationale: A downloadable API spec is a fair question for a cloud sandbox platform, so the axis applies. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path (all returned 404). The llms.txt file, markdown docs and SDK references are documentation or developer building blocks, not a machine-readable API specification, and the community gRPC mention points to no published spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
